S1_critical.definition: suspected data loss, security issue, or live product down for all
S1_critical.action: escalate to KingCode same day; user told it's escalated

S3_normal.definition: single-user defect, wrong display, FAQ question

S4_low.action: logged; answered when shipped or declined with reason

escalation: triage first: KB answer -> reproduce -> escalate
technical defect with repro (device/OS/browser/version/time/steps) -> ENG-REL via CWI_Results
public status updates -> drafted by CWI_Care, verified by KingCode before posting
hard_lines: never promise fixes, dates, or payouts
